gisSource: King County GIS Property/KingCo_Parcels and Property/KingCo_PropertyInfo
sourceSpatialReference: EPSG:3857 / WGS 1984 Web Mercator Auxiliary Sphere (source service wkid 102100/latestWkid 3857)

map.boundsStatus: verified from KingCo_Parcels service extent converted to WGS84

optionalLayers.label: County parcels
optionalLayers.joinBehavior: PIN -> White Rabbit accountNum/sourceParcelId, but PIN has duplicate geometry records; OBJECTID -> unique GIS feature id; viewport chunks and search shards are built but remain activation gated
optionalLayers.renderStrategy: build-time official source fetch, offline universal mapping, viewport chunks, capped runtime loader

optionalLayers.label: Owner/appraisal
optionalLayers.joinBehavior: PIN joins address, land value, improvement value, zoning, lot size, property type, and use fields; current owner fields remain source-needed
optionalLayers.renderStrategy: build-time official source fetch, offline owner/appraisal normalization, viewport chunks, capped runtime loader

optionalLayers.label: Parcel dimensions
optionalLayers.joinBehavior: PropertyInfo exposes LOTSQFT, KCA_ACRES, Shape.STArea(), and Shape.STLength(); ParcelLabels service needs inspection for dimension labels
optionalLayers.renderStrategy: build-time official source inspection, offline mapping, viewport chunks

optionalLayers.label: Block, subdivision, and map-grid context
optionalLayers.source: PLAT_NAME, MAJOR, MINOR fields in PropertyInfo parcels
optionalLayers.joinBehavior: PIN-keyed PropertyInfo fields include PLAT_NAME plus MAJOR/MINOR; additional plat/block services still need source inspection
optionalLayers.renderStrategy: build-time official source inspection, offline joins, viewport chunks

optionalLayers.label: Permits and certificates of occupancy
optionalLayers.joinBehavior: source-needed: parcel/account, normalized address, or spatial point-in-parcel join
optionalLayers.renderStrategy: build-time official source verification, offline permit normalization, viewport-safe chunks

optionalLayers.label: Zoning intelligence
optionalLayers.source: KCA_ZONING field in King County PropertyInfo parcels
optionalLayers.joinBehavior: PIN-keyed KCA_ZONING field gives zoning text; city zoning polygons/cases remain source-needed where county parcel text is not enough
optionalLayers.renderStrategy: build-time official source verification, offline joins, viewport chunks, capped runtime loader

optionalLayers.label: Floodplain intelligence
optionalLayers.joinBehavior: source-needed: FEMA/local floodplain spatial join keyed back to parcel/account IDs
optionalLayers.renderStrategy: build-time official source verification, offline parcel centroid spatial join, viewport-safe sharded parcel ID lookup

optionalLayers.label: Migration and demand
optionalLayers.joinBehavior: source-needed: aggregate Census/ACS/IRS or approved demand geography joined by tract/block group/market, not individual people
optionalLayers.renderStrategy: build-time aggregate demand scoring, offline geography-to-parcel join, viewport-safe parcel index lookup

publicSourceDiscovery.priorityReason: Major West Coast market with mature GIS and permitting data sources.
sourceRules: Use official county, assessor/appraiser, GIS, municipal, state, or federal sources first.
Do not activate this county until exact parcel counts and join keys are verified.
Do not infer owner phone/email from permits, contractors, applicants, or scraped pages.

ownerEnrichment.officialJoinKey: PIN -> address, land/improvement value, zoning, lot size, property type, and present use fields; owner name remains source-needed
ownerEnrichment.noOfficialEmailFieldNote: No official owner name, owner phone, or owner email field is exposed by the verified layers inspected. Do not infer owner contact fields.

fields.ownerPhone: No official owner phone field verified
fields.ownerEmail: No official owner email field verified

joinKeys.primaryParcelAccount: PIN -> White Rabbit accountNum/sourceParcelId; one-to-many geometry joins allowed because duplicate PIN values exist
joinKeys.appraisal: PIN -> APPRLNDVAL, APPR_IMPR, LOTSQFT, KCA_ACRES, PROPTYPE, PREUSE_CODE, PREUSE_DESC
joinKeys.land: PIN -> LOTSQFT, KCA_ACRES, KCA_ZONING, PROPTYPE, PREUSE_CODE, PREUSE_DESC
joinKeys.secondaryParcelGisId: OBJECTID -> White Rabbit gisParcelId and unique GIS feature id
joinKeys.blockLabels: PLAT_NAME plus MAJOR/MINOR direct fields; additional plat/block source inspection remains build-needed
joinKeys.dimensions: LOTSQFT, KCA_ACRES, Shape.STArea(), and Shape.STLength() available; ParcelLabels MapServer needs inspection for segment dimension labels
joinKeys.permits: source-needed: parcel/account ID, address match, spatial join, or combination
joinKeys.zoning: KCA_ZONING field is PIN-keyed parcel zoning text; municipal zoning polygons/cases remain source-needed
joinKeys.floodplain: source-needed: FEMA/local floodplain parcel centroid spatial join keyed to parcel/account IDs
joinKeys.migrationDemand: source-needed: aggregate geography join, not individual people

productionGap: Pilot source verified with full viewport chunks and production search shards built, but PIN duplicate handling, current owner source, permits/CO, complete zoning detail, floodplain, development signals, migration/demand, PMTiles/vector tiles, and activation QA are not built yet.
pilotNotes: Do not activate this county in the app. Do not redesign any pages. The King source is verified and the map/search parcel service is built, but duplicate-PIN handling, owner source, optional layers, and explicit activation review remain gated.
